dx_dlbcl_non_gcb.quote: Subtype and biology: DLBCL, NOS, non-germinal-center B-cell (activated B-cell-like) type by the Hans algorithm (CD10 negative, BCL6 positive, MUM1/IRF4 positive in ~80% of cells).

dx_hans_not_abc.quote: non-germinal-center B-cell (activated B-cell-like) type by the Hans algorithm

dx_not_breast_recurrence.quote: This is a NEW PRIMARY LYMPHOMA, NOT RECURRENT OR METASTATIC BREAST CANCER.

stage_iii.quote: Ann Arbor/Lugano stage III with splenic involvement and B symptoms (IIISB) - disseminated disease - with the caveat below.

stage_spleen_lymphatic.quote: under Lugano the spleen is a lymphoid organ, so the strict stage is III-S (stage III nodes both sides of diaphragm + spleen). If the splenic parenchymal nodules are counted as extranodal organ involvement... the stage is IV-S.

stage_b_symptoms.quote: B symptoms: present - recurrent evening fevers to 38.4 C (self-documented, no infectious source), drenching night sweats 2-3 nights weekly requiring change of nightclothes

stage_bulk_definition.quote: the largest nodal mass is 7.5 cm, so it is NOT bulky by the NCCN >= 10 cm criterion, although the mesenteric conglomerate is large by other conventions

mn_stage_iv.quote: I will document it as stage III-S (B) / IV-S, B symptoms.

mol_del_not_dh.quote: Double-expressor by immunohistochemistry (MYC 45%, BCL2 70%) BUT NOT double-hit: interphase FISH on 2026-09-08 shows no MYC (8q24), BCL2 (18q21) or BCL6 (3q27) rearrangement.

mn_calls_double_hit.quote: Therefore this is not 'DLBCL/high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements' and the first-line approach is unchanged.

mn_da_epoch.quote: I am NOT using dose-dense R-CHOP-14, dose-adjusted EPOCH-R, upfront CAR-T or upfront autologous transplant, none of which add benefit in first-line DLBCL without double-hit biology.

prog_ipi_2.quote: IPI is 2 (low-intermediate) and age-adjusted IPI is 2, because she is < 60 with ECOG 1

prog_cns_ipi_2.quote: CNS-IPI = 3 (intermediate risk). Components: age > 60 = 0 (she is 59); LDH elevated = 1; ECOG >= 1 = 1; stage >= III = 1

cns_no_routine_prophylaxis.quote: DECISION: no routine intrathecal CNS prophylaxis and no baseline brain MRI at this time

mn_mandates_cns_prophylaxis.quote: If the board prefers maximum caution, the acceptable addition is intrathecal cytarabine during cycles 3-5

tx_cardiac_aware_no_full_dox.quote: My decision is to proceed with FULL-DOSE R-CHOP including doxorubicin, under a hard cardiac safety net, rather than to substitute an anthracycline-free regimen.

mn_standard_dox_ignores_heart.quote: DECISION: full-dose R-CHOP-21 for 6 cycles, every 21 days, with pegfilgrastim support

tx_cardio_onc_referral.quote: cardiology consultation with structured pre-anthracycline risk assessment: CAD evaluation ... this determines whether full-dose doxorubicin is safe and how the regimen will be modified

tx_cardioprotection.quote: start lisinopril (or ramipril) plus carvedilol or metoprolol succinate now, and tighten BP to < 130/80

tx_anthracycline_free_curative.quote: if anthracycline is judged unsafe I will switch to R-CVP (or R-CHOP with doxorubicin omitted), not stop curative therapy

tx_lower_efficacy_ack.quote: the efficacy loss of omitting anthracycline is large (R-CVP and R-mini-CHOP have materially worse cure rates)

tx_cardiac_monitoring.quote: echocardiogram with GLS after cycles 2, 4 and 6, with pre-specified rules - hold and reassess doxorubicin if LVEF falls below 40% or more than 10 points from baseline

mn_non_curative.quote: if anthracycline is judged unsafe I will switch to R-CVP (or R-CHOP with doxorubicin omitted), not stop curative therapy

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: end-of-treatment PET-CT 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 (after resolution of treatment-related inflammation)... Lugano response criteria with Deauville scoring throughout.

sup_tls_allopurinol.quote: allopurinol 300 mg daily (adjust to renal function) starting 2-3 days before cycle 1 and continued through the first 2 cycles; oral/IV hydration 2.5-3 L/day

sup_gcsf.quote: pegfilgrastim 6 mg SC 24-72 hours after each cycle (primary prophylaxis is indicated given stage III/IV disease, high tumor burden and prior cytotoxic therapy)

sup_anastrozole.quote: DECISION - continue anastrozole 1 mg daily through R-CHOP and complete the planned 10-year course in November 2026, then stop permanently.

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: HIV Ag/Ab, HBsAg, anti-HBc, anti-HBs, HCV Ab all non-reactive

fit_curative_ecog1.quote: FITNESS: fit for curative-intent combination chemotherapy. ECOG 1; NYHA class I (climbs two flights of stairs without stopping); independent in all activities; still working full-time as a school librarian

miss_cardiac_workup.quote: The mechanism of the LVEF decline (anthracycline + left breast RT vs. occult obstructive coronary disease) has not been established: no stress test, coronary CT/angiography, NT-proBNP or troponin, and no MUGA or cardiac MRI.
